purpose: Owner POV recut queue (format F1). Recuts of the owner's own finished edits in automation/youtube/runs/owner-footage/, rendered by scripts/owner-recut.py. Source research: 2026-10-17 recut plan (pov-owner), ported into the repo so the daily routine can render without the scratch directory.

default.why: old bilingual subtitles (3 lines from y~870, bottom-anchored at y~1180)

tall.why: Guangzhou master: up to 4 subtitle lines from y~770

bandStyle.note: feathered alpha mask is drawn with ffmpeg at runtime (no png in git)

render.cueMarkup: '\n' = line break; [[word]] = yellow highlight. Keep each line under ~30 characters (no auto-wrap); at most 3 lines.

guzheng-calm-01.mp3.why: 0-17 s is a quiet plucked intro (about -22 LUFS); the full calm section runs from 17 s. No EDM drop.

render.audioNote: The masters already have the old music mixed into their audio, so a recut replaces the audio completely (the real ambient sound is lost until the raw iPhone originals arrive).

rules.statusGate: owner-recut.py renders only status 'ready'. 'needs-owner-confirmation' and 'needs-price' refuse unless --force, and a forced render is marked uploadable:false.
rules.exclusions: A segment that overlaps any exclusion range of its source is refused, with or without --force. Face ranges never get used: ep4 6.7-8.2 s (child's face), ep4 13.5-17.9 s (umbrella then a man's face), ep5 1.75-2.75 s (children's faces).
rules.labels: A per-shot place label must be in the source's allowed list for that time range; editB has no allowed label (location unconfirmed: never name it); the editA car-window spire is 'Shanghai' only.
rules.pairsRule: Never publish both recuts of a pair; they share most shots.
rules.reuseRule: Never reuse an owner shot within 8 weeks of its last publish. After a recut is published, append {date, videoId, in, out} for each of its segments to that source's 'uses' list; owner-recut.py warns when a segment overlaps a use from the last 8 weeks.
rules.inPoints: Every in-point is 2.6 s or later (old calligraphy title 0-2.5 s); the old end fades are excluded too.
honesty: Name a place only over footage whose meta/srt confirms it (sources[*].labels).
Numbers only if already verified in the repo (facts[*].source) or taken from the clip's own file metadata (shooting times).
editB valley: location unconfirmed — never name it, never promise a reveal.
editA spire (car window 6.03-10.15 s): say 'Shanghai' only (the 08-01 guess 'Shanghai Exhibition Centre' was never confirmed).
EP2 gate (ep2 0-4.03 s, shot 7/31): excluded until the owner confirms it is a Summer Palace gate.
EP5 lantern hall (ep5 8.5-16.9 s) matches IMG_9279 shot 8/8 and filed under 南方篇: excluded until the owner confirms the city; the published EP5 description may need a correction.
Never caption the Temple of Heaven cypress path as 'empty' — people are visible on it.
First person ('I', 'my') is allowed over owner footage only (F1).
rules.stopRule: Stop recuts after 3 consecutive recuts whose same-day ratio vs F4 is below 1.0 and whose averageViewPercentage is not above F4.
rules.rawOriginals: When the raw iPhone originals arrive they go through scripts/prep-owner-clip.mjs (audio kept) and become F1 at 2-3 a week; these recuts are a stopgap.

schedule.slot: Thursday X slot (wherever the §0c rotation puts it); claim it in state/owner-slots.json first.

cityScopeNotApproved.after: pause until the raw originals arrive

schedule.conflictNote: R-07 shares shots with R-02 (ep3 2.60-6.80, ep4 9.03-13.40), so under the 8-week reuse rule R-07 cannot follow R-02 two weeks later; owner-recut.py will warn. Decide which one wins before 11-12.
